research_scope: Direct-source follow-up on five canonical null race_restriction CaC-usable skills.

records.name: Spirit Stab
records.evidence: Prior repository batches explicitly reconciled Spirit Stab and retained null because reviewed evidence does not establish a CaC race/gender restriction. No new direct eligibility evidence warrants changing that result.

records.name: Split Finger Shot
records.evidence: Current canonical record remains CaC-usable with null race restriction. Reviewed repository evidence does not establish explicit retail CaC race/gender/form wording, so null is preserved.

records.name: Super Back Jump
records.evidence: Prior research identifies Super Back Jump as a CaC-usable Evasive, but no explicit narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction was established. Evasive classification and character usage are insufficient to infer race.

records.name: Super Dragon Fist
records.evidence: Prior dedicated research establishes Super Dragon Fist as a Future Warrior/CaC-usable Strike Super. No explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction was established in the reviewed evidence.

records.name: Super Drain
records.evidence: Prior repository research establishes Super Drain as a CaC-usable skill. Reviewed evidence does not provide explicit CaC race/gender/form eligibility wording; therefore null remains the evidence-safe value.

policy: Only explicit CaC eligibility wording establishing a narrower race/gender/form condition can populate race_restriction; preserve null otherwise.
